en.p: A random variable $X$ following the normal distribution $\mathrm{N}\left(m_1,\,\sigma_1^{2}\right)$ and a random variable $Y$ following the normal distribution $\mathrm{N}\left(m_2,\,\sigma_2^{2}\right)$ satisfy the following condition.

box: For every real number $x$, $\mathrm{P}(X\le x)=\mathrm{P}(X\ge 40-x)$ and $\mathrm{P}(Y\le x)=\mathrm{P}(X\le x+10)$.

en.p: When the value of $\mathrm{P}(15\le X\le 20)+\mathrm{P}(15\le Y\le 20)$, obtained using the standard normal table below, is $0.4772$, find the value of $m_1+\sigma_2$. (Here $\sigma_1$ and $\sigma_2$ are positive.) [4 points]
